question: If a + b + c = 10 ; a² + b² + c² = 38, what is the value of (a - b)² + (b - c)² + (c - a)²?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

If we put, a = 2, b= 3 and c = 5, 

then, a + b + c = 10 and a2 + b2 + c2 = 38

So,

(a - b)2 + (b - c)2 + (c - a)2

⇒ (2 - 3)² + (3 - 5)²&am
